title: Not Every Slow Hosted Agent Request Is a Cold Start
summary: Separate startup class, first answer text, stream completion, and overlapping traces using five historical Hosted Agent observations and a reproducible measurement plan.
sourceDocuments: Hosted Agent latency investigation and five-call results, September 30, 2026
Single-request latency measurement client and its configuration template
Supporting hosted-agent implementation and private-network validation notes
Microsoft Learn: hosted-agent latency diagnostics and session management
omissions: Original account, project, agent, deployment, tenant, subscription, session, request, response, resource, host, address, and local-path identifiers are omitted.
Private repository links, environment files, raw result files, diagnostic exports, original screenshots, and third-party graphics are not published.

The original client persists environment and correlation identifiers and does not collect completion trailers. It is not redistributed; focused in-page request and timing examples are illustrative, not a complete measurement client.

The separate seven-call Zenn study and separate tool-transaction capture are not included in the five-call measurement dataset. Unavailable per-call first-text and detailed header values are not reconstructed.
